Keep 'Retry summary:' and 'Failed!' parallel to the platform 'Test run summary: Failed!' wording. The '(s)' suffix follows the existing convention used elsewhere in this extension for counts that may be one.

The parenthetical is important: it states that these tests are already included in the 'succeeded' count rather than forming a fourth outcome category alongside failed/succeeded/skipped.
